rv.q: All of it amounts to a lot less than the sum of its parts: a laboured production of a laboured adaptation.
This is a great pity because somewhere in this hall of mirrors is an absorbing 75 minute play.

cn.t: This stage adaptation of Damian Barr's acclaimed memoir fails to capture the intimacy and impact of the source material, with critics finding it overlong and dramatically underwhelming despite its imaginative staging.
